TL;DR: Does anyone else want to work on Gromov-Witten invariants and co?

I'm hoping to (aspirational, long term goal!) be able to state results related to Gromov-Witten invariants and quantum cohomology, and eventually (auto?)formalise some of the results I'm working towards as part of my PhD.

There are quite a few things that this will probably require. To list just a few:

  • some theory of algebraic stacks (including some intersection theory)
  • various standard results about the cohomology/Chow groups of varieties
  • constructing moduli spaces/stacks of stable maps and proving basic properties about them
  • stable reduction (see TauCetiRoadmap#142) and other results about stable maps
  • the construction of the virtual fundamental class (see this paper)
  • defining Gromov-Witten invariants!

(and probably quite a few other important things that I'm forgetting about)

My goal with this thread is
a) Coordinate with others on this, since many prerequisites here might be of interest to other groups (and probably already being worked on? e.g. Stacks, etc)
b) Find other people that are interested in collaborating on this!

One nice outcome is that this would be a meaningful step towards formalising a few important results in contemporary algebraic geometry, e.g. this recent result.
Moduli spaces and results about cohomology of varieties are things I am interested in. Also doing some intersection theory would also be cool so I am happy to talk about these things.

I'm also interested in these, coming from the symplectic geometry side. (Though I'm also interested in these getting into mathlib, and it's not clear to me if/how advancing Tau Ceti is useful for that.)
